name: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo
short_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo is a half-marathon event in Iloilo City, Philippines, held on October 25, 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo is a half-marathon event scheduled for October 25, 2026, in Iloilo City, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the HOKA Midnight Run Asia brand, the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, with the half-marathon serving as the primary distance. Registration details have not yet been announced.

research_highlights: The Iloilo leg is a new addition to the series and takes place at Ayala Malls Atria, Mandurriao, Iloilo City on October 25, 2026, with distances of 21K, 10K and 5K.
First gun start is at 12:00 AM (midnight); organizers advise all runners to arrive early for assembly and check-in, with specific call times per category announced closer to race day.
Course descriptions (from race-listing sites, not yet participant-verified) describe it as a fast, flat night route along wide city roads and the Iloilo River Esplanade, suited to steady pacing.
The wider HOKA Midnight Run Asia series has been drawing large crowds elsewhere in the Philippines — the Manila leg reportedly gathered almost 15,000 runners.
The event is stated to be rain or shine, with no refund or transfer entitlement if the race is cancelled or delayed due to weather.
research_watchouts: No participant race reports or reviews could be found yet for the Iloilo edition specifically, since it is a new/future date on the calendar as of this search.

A runner commented on the organizer's Facebook page that results from the July 2026 Manila leg of the same series were still missing almost a month later and that the page was not responding to messages, suggesting possible post-race organizational/results delays in this event series.
Race bibs are non-transferable, and selling, swapping, or running under someone else's name can lead to disqualification or suspension from future events.
Being a midnight start in a tropical city, conditions are described (for the sister Cagayan de Oro leg) as warm and humid at night, which may apply similarly in Iloilo.
